subject: Evidence handoff & deletion-gap checklist for backup purge window
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Chris Reynolds <chris.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Compliance Team <compliance@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence handoff & deletion-gap checklist for backup purge window

Hi Chris / Acme Compliance team,

Thanks for the heads up about your upcoming purge test window (Nov 3–5). We want to make sure Redwood can provide sufficient evidence and a minimal-risk plan for the short deletion gap you mentioned in the DPA addendum.

Quick summary of what we'd like to align on before the purge test:
- Concrete list of evidence artifacts you need (snapshots, immutability logs, audit entries, access-listing).
- The exact retention gap you consider sensitive (e.g., 48 vs 72 hours after snapshot deletion).
- Whether you require an escrow snapshot or just signed attestations and a drive share.
- Any subprocessor-specific records (S3 lifecycle logs, secondary backup vendor manifests).

I've attached a lightweight checklist (retention-evidence-checklist.xlsx) that maps artifacts to owners. Kimberly and Karthik are looped for technical confirmation.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Chris — confirm the minimum artifact set by EOD 10/22.
2) Kimberly — confirm Redwood's ability to export the S3 purge manifest and an immutable audit export for the window.
3) Karthik — advise on short-term log-retention exceptions (if we need a temporary extension to satisfy evidence requests).
4) Schedule a 30-minute sync to finalize handoff and access (I've tentatively held 10/23 10:00 PT).

Attachments: retention-evidence-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Chris Reynolds <chris.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff & deletion-gap checklist for backup purge window

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Apologies for the short notice on the window — internal audit accelerated our timeline. For evidence we need:
- Snapshot manifest (timestamped), including manifest of dependent incremental deltas.
- S3 lifecycle & Object Delete Marker logs for the affected buckets covering a 7‑day window around the purge.
- Immutable audit export that shows the delete operation and the user/service principal.
- Hashes (where available) for top-level snapshots.

Regarding the sensitive gap: we need an escrow snapshot for 72 hours post-deletion OR, if you cannot provide escrow due to production constraints, a signed attestation + the full manifest and audit exports.

I'll confirm by EOD 10/22 whether Acme requires escrow (we're leaning toward escrow but I need procurement signoff).

Attached: s3-purge-plan.pdf (vendor timeline + expected object counts)

—Chris
Chris Reynolds
Security Operations Lead, Acme Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Reynolds <chris.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff & deletion-gap checklist for backup purge window

Thanks Chris — good details. A few technical notes and what we can deliver: 

What Redwood can produce:
- Snapshot manifest with timestamps and incremental chain mapping (JSON/CSV export).
- S3 lifecycle event logs and Delete Marker listings (we can provide a signed export covering the requested 7‑day window).
- Immutable audit export: we can provide WORM-anchored logs for delete API calls during the window — includes principal, request ID, and timestamp.
- Hashes for top-level snapshots where we have checksums; for object-level checksums we'll provide per-bucket manifest.

Constraints / ask back:
- Escrow snapshot: we can create a temporary escrow copy to an access-controlled AWS account but it requires a 24-hour lead to stage and validate. If Acme needs escrow immediately at purge start, we need confirmation by 10/28 to staff the transfer runbook and KMS key access.
- If Acme chooses signed attestation instead, we need a signed acceptance of the residual risk.

Temporary log-retention extension: by default we retain operational logs for 30 days. If you require a 90-day window around the purge, we can enable a short-term retention exception for the specific log streams, but that requires a change request and approval from our privacy team. Karthik — can you confirm operational impact and ETA for enabling a targeted retention extension?

Attachment: none in this message (refer to retention-evidence-checklist.xlsx from Marissa)

Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Reynolds <chris.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Oct 2025 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff & deletion-gap checklist for backup purge window

On Wed, Oct 22, 2025 at 08:46 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Temporary log-retention extension: by default we retain operational logs for 30 days. If you require a 90-day window around the purge, we can enable a short-term retention exception for the specific log streams, but that requires a change request and approval from our privacy team. Karthik — can you confirm operational impact and ETA for enabling a targeted retention extension?

Kimberly / Marissa / Chris —

We can do a targeted retention extension for the following streams without broad policy changes:
- S3 lifecycle notifications (bucket-level)
- Audit API call logs (management plane)
- Object delete marker index (service runtime)

Impact: ~<1% storage delta for the affected buckets over the 90-day window; no change to production-serving KV caches. The process: submit an internal retention-exception change ticket, run a one-time export to an escrow bucket if requested, and flip the retention guard for the specific streams.

ETA: If we get approval and the ticket before 10/28, we can have exports staged and exception active by 11/02 (one day before the purge). Creating an escrow snapshot (to the access-controlled account) will add ~6 hours of staging and verification work on the scheduled day.

Operational note: ensure KMS policy for the escrow account allows decrypt for our Ops user. Chris — if Acme plans escrow, please share the target AWS account ID and the KMS key alias.

—Karthik
Staff Engineer, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Chris Reynolds <chris.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Compliance Team <compliance@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Oct 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff & deletion-gap checklist for backup purge window — action list + 10/28 decision cutoff

Thanks all — recap and final asks: 

Decisions required by 10/28 EOD (Acme):
- Escrow required? (If yes, provide target AWS account ID & KMS alias.)
- Artifact list confirmed? (manifest, delete logs, immutable audit export, hashes)

Redwood commitments (if escrow requested and approval received by 10/28):
- Stage escrow snapshot 11/02, validate, and hand off access controls (6 hours staging).
- Activate targeted 90-day retention exception for the named streams and produce exports covering 7 days around purge.
- Provide signed attestation template if Acme prefers that route instead of escrow.

Attachments (for handoff): retention-evidence-checklist.xlsx; s3-purge-plan.pdf (from Acme).

I'll hold the 10/23 sync for now but will cancel if we have a clear decision by EOD 10/22. If escrow is confirmed, we will schedule a detailed runbook rehearsal the week of 10/27.

Open items for Redwood ops: Laura — please prepare the export runbook and a one-page attestation template.

Chris — appreciate the quick turnaround on procurement; please ping when you have the AWS account ID so Karthik can validate KMS scope.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Manager, Security & Ops
Redwood Inference
